name: Naaman
summary: The captain of the king of Syria's army, a great and brave man who had leprosy. Washing in the Jordan at Elisha's word made him clean, and he vowed to worship only the LORD.

key_moments.title: Seeks a Cure in Israel
key_moments.description: A young girl taken captive from Israel served Naaman's wife, and she wished her master could see the prophet in Samaria, who would cure his leprosy. The king of Syria sent Naaman to the king of Israel with a letter and rich gifts.

key_moments.title: Healed in the Jordan
key_moments.description: Elisha sent word for Naaman to wash seven times in the Jordan. Naaman stormed off angry, but his servants talked him round, and his skin became like a little child's.

key_moments.title: Vows to Worship Only the LORD
key_moments.description: Naaman said he now knew that the whole earth had no God except in Israel. He asked for two mules' loads of earth, for he would offer sacrifice to no other god but the LORD.
